question:
In the following question, select the related letter pair from the given alternatives.

JRVP : IQUO :: ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

JRVP : IQUO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d425d0902542bf36f30e45746e0511254190d64c77e7b01b97efac2d25491928.png] 

So checking each option one by one:

Option 1) QJBV : PIAU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f78979a7ee036d0aeef2c203c8967ef9b16b271ec0922b9d6a0b95824e8bacee.png] 

Option 2) NOPX : ZWXV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af201b117301b8bd657e509389ac3a9d1303e533b2fc2f8c5a6286fa4b488e42.png] 

Option 3) NDUR : ABOC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0a696c66f6c7fd703107960c5ec8fe07c52e1aabd5fcf642bc7e152efe5a83f.png] 

Option 4) WWYR : URUO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4526f6a7f96420199fde5110ae1fcf6a6a871463e072845d4bc28c5eba685f57.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "QJBV : PIAU" follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
